summary: Since 0.24 the voice button draws its own icon instead of the words mic, stop and retry. An app that hid those words with CSS and drew its own icon (::before/::after, content:) now shows two icons.
howTo: Remove the app's own icon and the CSS that hid the text, or style the shipped icon through the data attributes instead: the button is [data-component="voice-input-addon"] (VoiceInputButton: [data-component="voice-input-button"]) with data-state idle, connecting, recording or failed; its icon is svg[data-icon="mic" | "stop" | "busy"], the retry button [data-action="retry-recording"] with svg[data-icon="retry"]. To keep only an own icon, hide the shipped one ([data-component="voice-input-addon"] svg[data-icon] { display: none }) and keep drawing yours. No hidden text is needed for screen readers: the buttons carry a localized aria-label.
